# Ballast: Quit PMO

Private on-device urge support and streak tracking for adults quitting PMO.
Requires iOS 26 or later. No account. Full urge flow and slip support are free.
Pro adds Insights, the remaining course, full history, extra habits and plans, and weekly review.
Apple and RevenueCat process purchases and identifiers; personal entries stay on device.
A self-tracking and educational tool, not treatment.

- [Official website](https://atabany.github.io/ballast-site/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6803731313)
- [Support](https://atabany.github.io/ballast-site/support.html)
- [Privacy](https://atabany.github.io/ballast-site/privacy.html)
